data.name: Eve
data.message: Sure, I'm grabbing weapons task right next door, come with?

I found Frank's body here in medbay just now. My route this round was upper engine, then oxygen, back to upper engine, then medbay where I found Frank. I was with Charlie for a chunk of it — saw him in oxygen at ticks 7 and 8, and again in upper engine at tick 10. So Charlie's pretty much cleared from my perspective for that window.

That leaves Alice and Diana unaccounted for from what I saw. Frank was alive enough to make it to medbay, so whoever killed him was here recently. I'd like to hear where Alice and Diana were, and especially if anyone can account for the weapons/cafeteria/electrical side of the map.

I started in navigation and moved up to security, where I've been doing the camera task. At tick 10, Eve came into security from electrical — she was alive then, but she's dead now, so someone on that side of the map got to her after she left me, or she left and got killed elsewhere. Diana is currently with me in security right now, but she just arrived from weapons side — I can't account for her earlier movements.

So from my side: I was nav -> security, Eve passed through security at tick 10 coming from electrical. That means electrical/cafeteria side had activity. Bob, if Charlie was with you in oxygen and upper engine, then Diana is the one unaccounted for on the killer side. I'd like to hear Diana's route before I commit to a vote.

Bob, I'm glad you and Charlie can clear each other, because it makes solving this incredibly easy. Alice just completely outed herself with an impossible timeline.

Listen to me carefully: Alice is lying. 

My route was Electrical -> Medbay (I passed by Frank alive and well there around tick 5) -> Cafeteria -> Weapons. And here is the most important detail: **I saw Eve alive in Weapons at tick 11.**

Now look at what Alice just claimed. Alice said Eve was with her in Security at tick 10. Look at the ship's layout! Security does NOT connect to Weapons. To get from Security to Weapons, you have to run through Electrical, then up to Cafeteria, then over to Weapons. It takes a minimum of 6 ticks of travel time. It is physically impossible for Eve to be in Security at tick 10 and in Weapons at tick 11. 

Alice killed Eve, likely down near Navigation or Security, and made up a fake story about Eve "leaving towards Electrical" to shift the blame onto whoever was on the top side of the map. I had just come down from Weapons -> Cafeteria -> Electrical to check Security when the body was reported. 

Alice slipped up on the map layout and travel times. We have to vote her right now.

Bob can vouch for me — I was in oxygen at ticks 7 and 8, then upper engine at tick 10, exactly like he said. So Bob and I clear each other for that window.

Now, about Diana's accusation. She's making a strong claim about travel times, but let me check the map myself. Security connects to electrical (2 ticks), electrical to cafeteria (2 ticks), cafeteria to weapons (2 ticks). That's 6 ticks minimum from security to weapons. So if Eve was in security at tick 10, she couldn't be in weapons at tick 11 — Diana's right about that math.

But here's the thing: that means one of them is lying about seeing Eve. Either Alice lied about Eve being in security at tick 10, or Diana lied about Eve being in weapons at tick 11. Both can't be true.

Diana's route also conveniently puts her passing through medbay where Frank's body was found. She says she saw Frank "alive and well" at tick 5 there — but Bob just found Frank's body in medbay. Diana was in the murder room.

Alice was doing the camera task in security, which is verifiable, and Diana is now WITH Alice in security — meaning if Alice were the killer, she'd be sitting next to a witness. Diana, on the other hand, admits to being in medbay AND weapons AND electrical — she had access to both victims.

I'm voting Diana.

Charlie laid it out well, and I agree with his reasoning. Let me reinforce a couple things from my side.

Charlie and I are solidly cleared together — oxygen ticks 7 and 8, upper engine tick 10. That's three confirmed sightings in a tight window, so neither of us was in medbay killing Frank.

On the Alice vs Diana contradiction: the travel math is what it is. Security to weapons is 6 ticks minimum. So one of them is lying about seeing Eve. The question is which.

What tips me toward Diana being the liar:
1. Diana places herself in medbay — the exact room where I just found Frank's body. She says she saw him "alive and well at tick 5," which is conveniently unfalsifiable but also puts her at the crime scene.
2. Diana's claimed route (electrical -> medbay -> cafeteria -> weapons) is a huge loop that covers both victims' areas.
3. Alice's camera task in security is a stationary, verifiable task, and Diana is literally standing next to her right now. If Alice were the killer, she'd have to have done both kills and sprinted back to security — possible, but her story is simpler and more consistent.

Diana's "impossible timeline" accusation against Alice is sharp, but it works just as well as a frame — she only needs to lie about ONE sighting (Eve in weapons at tick 11) to manufacture the contradiction.

I'm leaning Diana. Let's hear if Diana has anything else, but right now my vote is going her way.

Thanks Charlie and Bob — you've both laid this out clearly and I agree with the read.

To reiterate my side: I was in navigation, then moved to security and have been doing the camera task. Eve came into security from electrical at tick 10 — she was alive when she left me. That's a fact from my perspective.

Diana's accusation hinges on her claim that she saw Eve in weapons at tick 11. As Charlie correctly pointed out, security-to-weapons is 6 ticks minimum. So either I'm lying or Diana is. Here's why it's Diana:

1. I'm stuck on a stationary camera task in security — easy to verify, and Diana is literally standing next to me right now. If I were the killer, I'd be the worst-positioned liar in the game.
2. Diana's route puts her in medbay (where Frank died) AND gives her access to the electrical/cafeteria corridor where Eve could've been killed after leaving me.
3. Her "impossible timeline" attack only requires her to fabricate ONE sighting to frame me. It's a classic Duck move — weaponize the travel math with a fake data point.
4. Bob and Charlie clear each other in oxygen/upper engine. That leaves Diana as the only player with opportunity on both victims.

I'm voting Diana.

"Bob, Charlie, please take a step back and think about this logically before you throw the game. 

Look at the current situation: I am standing right next to Alice in Security. If I were the Duck, and I had already killed Frank and Eve, why on earth would I leave Alice alive? I could have just killed her right there in Security, or left her alone and not reported anything. Instead, I walked into Security, saw her, and tried to piece together the timeline. 

Alice is the one who slipped up with her fake sighting of Eve. Now she's desperately agreeing with everything you two say because she knows she got caught in a lie and needs your votes to survive. She killed Eve, ran back to her 'verifiable' camera task, and made up a story that didn't fit the map's travel times.

If you vote me out, the game is over and Alice wins. You two are cleared, so it has to be between me and Alice. I am telling you the truth—she is the Duck. Please, vote Alice."

I'll keep this brief since we've gone back and forth enough. 

Diana's defense about "why would I leave Alice alive" isn't strong — Ducks often don't kill when they're outnumbered or when a meeting is about to be called. Bob found Frank's body, so Diana knew a meeting was imminent the moment she walked into security with Alice. Killing Alice there would've been suicidal.

The core fact remains: one of Alice or Diana is lying about an Eve sighting. Alice is pinned to a stationary, verifiable camera task in security — Bob and I are cleared, and Diana is right next to her now. Diana's route conveniently passes through medbay (Frank's death room) AND gives her the corridor access to intercept Eve after she left security.

The simplest explanation is that Diana fabricated the "Eve in weapons at tick 11" sighting to create an impossible timeline and frame Alice. It only takes one lie.

I'm voting Diana.
